yes.0: You know what we do, right? We steal the queen's treasures to, ah, help the poor. That's right. Help the poor. Now, to attack the transport group carrying her treasures, we need a rope. But first, I need material to craft the rope. You with me so far?
yes.1: Us desert folk make rope out of #b#t4000329##k by drying and braiding it. Could you get some from #r#o2100102##k monsters? #b40#k will make a nice, long rope for... completely innocent purposes.

no.0: Hey, if you aren't going to help, why'd you bother me in the first place?

1.0: Who-who is it?! Ohhh, you're the one that offered to help the Sand Bandits! Ah, hahaha, yes, yes. So did you get the #t4000329#s?

yes.0: Ah, yes, this will definitely help us Sand Bandits do good in the world... It's people like you that makes my job so much easier...

item.0: Didn't I ask for #b40 #t4000329##k items? You need to collect at least that many if you want to help the Sand Bandits... #r#o2100102##k monsters should have them.
